## 1 · Brand Mention → Slack Alert

**What it does:** Polls the web for fresh mentions of your brand/topic across 50+ platforms and posts each NEW one to a Slack channel. Deduped — you never get the same mention twice.

**Setup**
1. **MentionFox Trigger** → set *Topic* to your brand and pick a poll cadence (Trigger settings → Poll Times).
2. **Slack** → connect your Slack credential and choose the channel.
3. Activate the workflow.

**Credentials & key**
- The mention scan uses your **MentionFox connection token** (paste it into the *MentionFox API* credential — get it at **mentionfox.com/connect**).
- The paid FoxAPIs data nodes in the other templates authenticate with your **FoxAPIs API key** (`fxp_live_…`) from **foxapis.com**, which spends **FoxAPIs credits**. That is *not* a MentionFox connection token.

**Credit cost:** mention scan = **3 FoxAPIs-equivalent credits per source** scanned per poll. Narrow *Sources* (e.g. `reddit,twitter,hackernews`) to control spend. Slack is free.

Pricing: https://mentionfox.com/pricing

nodes.name: New Mention
nodes.notes: Polls scan_for_mentions and emits only mentions not seen before (dedupe by source_url). Set Topic to your brand. Uses the MentionFox connection token.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: One Slack message per new mention. No auto-reply — this is an alert only.
